Catch a local match on holiday

Upcoming top-flight fixtures in holiday countries, ranked by an atmosphere score you can check: derby, what is at stake in the table and the home crowd’s reputation. For each one we show how tourists can get tickets and a sourced typical price.

Fixtures listed5792 Nov 2026 – 20 Dec 2026
Clubs covered214in 14 countries
Clubs with a sourced price48the rest say “not published”

Every fixture is checked against the league’s or FA’s own fixture list where one is publicly readable, and each card names its source and check date. confirmed means the official source shows that date and kick-off time. date confirmed, time not set means the league has fixed the day but not yet the time. provisional means the date and time still come from a public scoreboard feed and have not been confirmed against an official-grade source. Kick-off times are in the stadium’s local zone, labelled on each card. Always check the club’s official site before you book travel.

Matchday Abroad is an independent guide for UK fans who want to see a local match on holiday. It is part of Price of Football. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to any club, league or ticket seller. Club names are used for identification only, and we do not use club badges or logos.

Every price, capacity, rivalry and atmosphere note links to its source with the date we checked it. If we could not find a figure from a source we trust, we say “not published”; we never estimate. We do not show live prices or live sold-out status. Ticket links go only to official club or league ticketing. We never link to resale or betting sites. Fixture dates can change, so always confirm on the club’s official site before you travel.
